message.content:
[routing packet]
Operations wants a weekly list of parcels that have been sitting in a locker too long. Add src/reports/overdue-parcels.mjs with a function overdueParcelsCsv(parcels, now) (parcels is an array of parcel records, now is a Date) that returns the list as CSV text. Include only parcels whose status is 'stored' and whose arrivedAt is more than 7 days before now, one line per parcel, with these columns in this order: parcel id, locker id, recipient, arrival time, whole days waiting. Add a test for it.
